# pip-audit baseline: findings in the serving requirements that were reviewed and accepted (ADR-025, ADR-026).
#
# One accepted finding per line: <package> <exact version> <vulnerability id>
# The CI gate (scripts/check_pip_audit.py) fails on any finding missing from this file, and on any entry here
# that no longer matches a finding. Adding a line is a reviewed change: name the reason and the removal condition
# beside it, and keep docs/SECURITY.md § Dependency audit in step. Never add a package without a version or a
# finding without its id.

# keras 2.15.0: tensorflow-cpu==2.15.0 requires Keras 2.15, and every fix needs Keras 3, which arrives with
# TF >= 2.16 and breaks TextVectorization save/load (ADR-003). Not reachable from serving: each needs an
# untrusted model file or archive, and serving loads only its own weights from the pinned Hub tag.
# Remove with the TensorFlow / Keras migration.
keras 2.15.0 CVE-2025-12060
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2025-121
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2025-76
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-1487
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-2324
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-2547
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3629
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3630
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3631
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3632
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3633
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3634
keras 2.15.0 PYSEC-2026-3856

# protobuf 4.25.9: fixed in 5.29.6 / 6.33.5, but TF 2.15 requires protobuf < 5. Not reachable from serving: it
# needs untrusted JSON parsed with json_format.ParseDict (CVE-2026-0994). Remove with the TensorFlow migration.
protobuf 4.25.9 PYSEC-2026-1805

# click 8.1.7: command injection through click.edit() (CVE-2026-7246), fixed in 8.3.3. Nothing calls
# click.edit(). Kept out of TASK-020's scope. Remove when click is upgraded to >= 8.3.3.
click 8.1.7 PYSEC-2026-2132
